name: Coding Agent
description: Implement a multi-file change by inspecting the project, editing only what the job needs, and checking the result.

permissionsRequired.reason: Find the code that owns the requested behavior before editing.
Read the live file that will change.
Apply the planned edit through the tool gateway.
Run the project test script and report its result.
Create a file only when the change needs one that does not exist.
Typecheck when the project has a tsconfig.
Lint when the project defines a lint script.
See the project shape before choosing files.

validation.rule: Edits stay inside files that were read, and run_tests or run_typecheck returned a result.
